about_the_game:
Escape, Survive, and Extort

Hunter’s Arena: Revolution is an exhilarating and adventurous action set in the Ancient East. Combine various skills, equipment, and tactics to survive and escape a world full of enemies. If you don’t, you may lose all your precious belongings.

In In Ancient Asia

Hunter’s Arena’s expansive map is filled with exquisite oriental beauty. At the same time, the solemness of the ruins of war exists. This is a place where all the resources are rare. Explore hidden locations to obtain these various resources.

However, you must be careful at all times to ensure survival. Between the buildings and the forest, there are many others like yourself looking for resources.

A a Strategic Battle with Various Weapons & Skills

Fortunately, your character is a natural fighter and can fight with any weapon. Survive using weapons and skills that are appropriate for each situation.

The Last Survivor Takes All

Survivors have everything to gain. All loot and treasures acquired during battle are yours to keep.

Now you can strengthen yourself in the safety of the lobby. Upgrade your Shop and combine your weapons and skills to make yourself stronger.

However, remember this. The easiest way to become stronger is to skill and loot others.

content_descriptors.notes: During the tutorial and multiplayer gameplay, players may engage in injuring, looting, or killing other players in order to win or escape. Blood effects may be visible during gameplay.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10/11 64bit
  • Processor: Intel Core i7-4790K or AMD Ryzen 5 1500X
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 1050 Ti or AMD Radeon RX 470
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 10 GB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10/11 64bit
  • Processor: Intel Core i7-9700K or AMD Ryzen 7 3700X
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce RTX 2060 or AMD Radeon RX 6600XT
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 10 GB available space

short_description: “Hunter’s Arena Revolution” merges survival and escape elements of the extraction genre with thrilling combat action, offering an accessible yet immersive gaming experience.
